title: The Jackett Ranch
indexLine: My family bought a block of land in America. I went to look.
lede: In the '70s my family bought 8.5 acres in America for $5,000. Nobody had been to see it. So I went to have a look.
metaDescription: My family bought 8.5 acres in America for $5,000 in the 70s and nobody had been to see it. I went to look, then offered it up for free.

videos.title: Driving Across America to Find My Family's Forgotten Land
videos.label: Part 1
videos.desc: Tommy Jackett drives across America to see a block of land his family bought in the 1970s and nobody had visited.

videos.title: My Dad Is Giving Away His Land in America
videos.label: Part 2, a Short
videos.desc: Part 2 of the Jackett Ranch story, a YouTube Short: the family is giving away its land in America.

thread.text: Part 1. I drove across America to see it. Steep hill, no water, no power. As I say in the video, the Jacketts are down $5K, plus the taxes. At the end I offered the land up for free.
Part 2, a Short. The family's cutting its losses, so I put the land on the internet.

title: DJ Bodhi
indexLine: He wanted to be a DJ. I backed him.
lede: His creativity is electric. I just put a magnifying glass on it.
metaTitle: DJ Bodhi, Will Sparks and The Today Show | Tommy Jackett
metaDescription: A voice memo, a song, a Will Sparks surprise and a spot on The Today Show. The DJ Bodhi videos, in the order they happened.

videos.title: From Voice Memo to A Spotify Hit!
videos.desc: A voice memo that became a song, made with a music producer found on Fiverr.

videos.title: How My 6-Year-Old Created a Will Sparks-Inspired Banga!
videos.desc: A young DJ discovers Will Sparks and records a voice message to send him.

videos.title: Will Sparks Surprises Kid DJ Fan!
videos.desc: DJ Will Sparks makes a young fan's dream come true.

videos.title: Bodhi's Surprise LIVE on The Today Show!
videos.desc: The Today Show saw the video and invited Bodhi to Crown Casino in Melbourne.

videos.title: He FINALLY went to a Will Sparks Concert!
videos.desc: A young fan finally gets to a Will Sparks concert.

thread.text: It started with a voice memo on my phone. We found a producer on Fiverr and turned it into his first song.
Then he found Will Sparks and couldn't get enough. He asked if he could record a voice message to send him.
Will Sparks surprised him. His new song, Action Fear by DJ Daka, was out everywhere. DJ Daka is Bodhi.
The Today Show saw the video and called. We went to Crown Casino for his live TV debut.
Nearly three years on, he finally got to a Will Sparks concert. He's still obsessed.

title: oBike
indexLine: I went fishing for oBikes in the Yarra. Then ABC Radio rang.
lede: In September 2017 oBikes were everywhere in Melbourne, including the bottom of the Yarra. So I grabbed a hook.
metaTitle: oBike fishing in the Yarra | Tommy Jackett
metaDescription: In 2017 I went fishing for dumped oBikes in the Yarra River. Pedestrian TV ran it and ABC Radio Melbourne had me on.

videos.desc: Tommy Jackett goes fishing for dumped oBikes in the Yarra River in Melbourne.

videos.desc: Tommy Jackett fishes e-scooters out of the Yarra River.

thread.text: Fishing for oBikes. I went down to the Yarra with a hook and an afternoon.
Pedestrian TV ran it.
ABC Radio Melbourne had me on Melbourne Mornings.
The Rabbit Hole. Six minutes further down.
Did it again with e-scooters. Five out of the Yarra in under two hours, and 3AW rang.

title: The 7-Eleven cup
indexLine: The $3 cup fits inside the $2 cup.
lede: A bloke named Josh showed in 2016 that a $3 coffee fits in a $2 cup. My mate and I checked if it still did in 2018. It's old footage, so they may have fixed it.

thread.text: Coffee Rip-Off. Two minutes, two cups.

title: Domino's pepperoni
indexLine: They promised 100 pieces of pepperoni. I counted.
lede: Domino's promised 100 pieces of pepperoni. I ordered one and counted every piece.
metaTitle: Domino's 100 pieces of pepperoni | Tommy Jackett
metaDescription: Domino's promised 100 pieces of pepperoni. I ordered one and counted every piece, the way I counted the steps at the 1000 Steps.

videos.title: Domino's Promise 100 Pieces Of Pepperoni, So I Counted Them!
videos.desc: Tommy Jackett counts the pieces of pepperoni on a Domino's pizza that promises 100.

videos.title: The REAL Number Of Steps At The 1000 Steps
videos.desc: Tommy Jackett counts the steps at the 1000 Steps in Victoria.

thread.text: Before the pizza, the stairs. I counted the steps at the 1000 Steps and got 776. Pedestrian TV ran it.
Then I ordered a Domino's pizza that promised 100 pieces of pepperoni, and counted them.
